neighbours.label: preposition or connective right before an expected Global South megacity name (in / of / de + Dhaka, Lagos, Lima), predicting that city
fire: Informal settlements keep spreading on the edge of the sprawling megacity of Karachi.
Garment workers marched through the streets of the Bangladeshi capital, Dhaka.
Floods displaced thousands of slum residents in the Indonesian capital of Jakarta.
Minibus drivers went on strike in the crowded Kenyan capital, Nairobi.
Air pollution reached record levels in the Thai capital of Bangkok.
Street vendors were evicted from markets in the Peruvian capital, Lima.
Traffic gridlock is a daily problem in the Nigerian city of Lagos.
Water shortages hit poor districts of the Tanzanian city of Dar es Salaam.
quiet: Informal settlements keep spreading on the edge of the sprawling city every year.
Garment workers marched through the streets demanding higher wages.
Floods displaced thousands of slum residents after the heavy rains.
Minibus drivers went on strike over the rising price of fuel.
Air pollution reached record levels during the dry season.
Street vendors were evicted from markets without any warning.
Traffic gridlock is a daily problem for commuters and drivers.
Water shortages hit poor districts during the long summer.

notes: Card: ' in' x10 before Dhaka, Pathum Thani etc.; logit effect of the - pole promotes Nairobi, Lima, Dhaka, Jakarta, Bangkok, Dar. Probe: 'megacity of Lagos' 0.65 at ' of'.
